_doc: L6 retention contract (A239). One entry per scratch/target/verifier/worktree/failed-unit path. kind: dir-age (delete top-level children older than age_h, alarm when size stays above cap_mb), failed-units (reset-failed user units that failed longer ago than age_h), worktree-prune (git worktree prune in each listed repo). hosts: reap.sh runs an entry only on a listed host (hostname -s). exclude: optional shell globs on the child basename, matched children are never reaped (live claude-<uid> session dirs). path may start with ~ or $HOME.
